decision.reason: [ev-dc0dc0557b81] is just a one-line commit title. It says only that the ApplicationSet GitLab SCM provider was updated to "search on parent folder" and points to issue/PR #16253/#21491. It doesn't say what the search covered before or after, which ApplicationSet configurations (for example GitLab group/subgroup settings) are affected, or what happens to an existing generator's output if the operator does nothing. The PR or issue text, or an upgrade-guide entry, is needed to decide applicability and consequence.
